_meta.purpose: Teaching dataset for the Influencer Scout add-on session. Mirrors the field shape Modash returns so founders can practice discovery and negotiation against realistic data before paying for the actual platform.
_meta.warning: Every handle, name, bio and number is invented. Do not contact these accounts. Some handles will accidentally collide with real users on Instagram or YouTube, that is coincidence; the profile data attached here is fabricated and should not be assumed to describe the real account.
_meta.geography: India-first. Audience splits assume Indian D2C brands shipping primarily inside India, with select NRI-skewed creators included for VAHDAM-style global plays.
_meta.currency: INR. Indian creators almost always negotiate 20-40% below the listed rate estimate, especially when product gifting or affiliate components are bundled. Treat estimates as ceilings.
fields_added_for_teaching: credibility_score (= 1 - fake_follower_pct, kept separately for skim reading)
red_flags (Modash exposes the underlying signals but does not surface them as a list)
fit_notes (single line on why the creator fits a bucket)
buckets (which D2C brand category in the workshop this creator maps to)
